extra.final_summary:
Average flipper length by species (mm, after cleaning): Adelie 190.82, Chinstrap 200.13, Gentoo 217.00 (68 rows used).

Data problems found and fixed:
- flipper_length_mm had 2 impossible negative values (-200 in row 8, -187 in row 58), outside the rules-file range of 170–235 mm. Those rows were excluded (approved).
- 1 exact duplicate row (row 61) was removed to avoid double-counting (approved).

Notes/caveats:
- species labels were already clean (Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo), so no normalization was needed.
- sex has case variants (MALE/FEMALE) and 2 missing values, but the question doesn't use sex, so it was left alone.
- body_mass_g has one value written as text ("3,075"), but it's not used in this question and was left as-is.
